mapper.sql: id, region, title, description, reward_points, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.region, t.title, t.description, t.reward_points, t.status, t.created_at, COALESCE(c.status, 0) AS claim_status, c.id AS claim_id FROM creator_task t LEFT JOIN creator_task_claim c ON c.task_id=t.id AND c.user_id=#{userId} WHERE t.region=#{region} AND t.status=1 AND t.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_task WHERE region=#{region} AND status=1 AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM creator_task WHERE region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_task WHERE region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM creator_task WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creator_task_claim(task_id, user_id, region, status) VALUES(#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{region}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_task_claim SET status=2, completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=1
mapper.select: SELECT points FROM app_user WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_points_log(user_id, type, action, biz_id, change_amount, balance_after, remark) VALUES(#{userId}, 2, 'creator_task', #{bizId}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{remark})
INSERT INTO creator_task(region, title, description, reward_points, status) VALUES(#{region}, #{title}, #{description}, #{rewardPoints}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_task SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, reward_points=#{rewardPoints}, status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
